The front (−z) is the portico, facing down the Rue Soufflot.

Height: the highest point is 83 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the corner: Corinthian portico with pediment and the tall drum and dome, daylight
  2. view of the rear and side of the cross-shaped body with the drum and dome above, trees in front
  3. elevated view of the whole portico front and flank across the square, daylight

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: Greek-cross plan in pale cream limestone. A deep Corinthian portico (6 columns across the front, 3 deep) with a pediment stands on the front (-z) and leads into the nave. Four cross arms are blank-walled, with low pediments at the arm ends. A tall colonnaded drum carries a grey lead dome, and a small lantern with a cross tops it at 83 m. Mostly blank walls, with a few arched windows on the flanks.
